rationale.edition: All 32 changed paths live under web/src/** (anomaly_detection, alerts, common, lib/core/Button, views/slos), tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts, and scripts/translations + web/src/locales. None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and the paths carry none of the enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management). The anomaly-detection backend does live in o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/anomaly_detection, but this diff touches only the shared OSS frontend/test trees, not that backend, so edition=oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipping: trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty (no tests-added label or skip request), and the change is user-facing — it edits frontend components under web/src. A Playwright E2E spec is modified in the diff, which is not an auto-skip; it instead sets existing_tests_in_diff=true and routes to enhance.
rationale.e2e: Warranted: the diff changes user-exercisable UI in the anomaly-detection alert config — the sensitivity hint reworded from 'p97' to an interpolated '97%'/'99%', the 'Percentile' label renamed to 'Level' with a new info tooltip, a new Detection Function tooltip, a new caption under the preview chart, and IacRegistryLinks now rendered as visible outline buttons. These flows need browser verification.
rationale.area: Alerts — the bulk of the UI changes are in the anomaly-detection alert config (web/src/components/anomaly_detection/**), and the existing spec lives in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js, so Alerts is where the sibling specs live.
rationale.group: Alerts — the modified spec alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js is registered to the Alerts shard (it appears under append.Alerts in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.ent.json, joined to the OSS Alerts group), so new or updated cases belong in that run_files shard.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff modifies tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Alerts/alerts-anomaly-detection.spec.js — a real Playwright E2E spec — adding coverage for the interpolated sensitivity hint (97%/99%). It covers the new hint behavior but not the new tooltips, preview caption, or IacRegistryLinks button-label changes. The many web/src/**/*.spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests and do not count as E2E coverage.
